messages:
Nina: Quick sync — CloudStack asked to run a joint "office hours" style webinar + on-site demo at their booth next month. Need to lock speakers, demo machines, and swag pickup. Who can own ops?
Josh: I can take ops for the demo kit and AV checklist. Need shipping ETA from HW partner.
Liam: I'll own the speaker coords. Pinged CloudStack for final speaker list and bios. Deadline for slides?
Nina: Thanks — slides due 5 business days before event. Also want a 30m dry run 2 days prior.
Maya: For demo infra, can we get a staging endpoint with 5-minute token lifetime? Partners need ephemeral creds.
Samir: Yes, we can provision a staging key + a small Dedicated pool. Maya, what perf SLAs for the demo?
Maya: Target p95 < 300ms for simple prompts. If we hit token throttling, fallback to smaller model.
Josh: Shipping note: partner prefers booth arrival 48hrs before. I'll coordinate courier. Need contact at CloudStack.
Liam: CloudStack contact is @ellen_cs — she confirmed two speakers, one product lead and one solutions engineer. I'll request short bios by EOD Thu.
Nina: Swag plan: 200 stickers, 100 tees, 50 demo dongles. Who has budget signoff? :moneybag:
Josh: Marketing already approved swag budget under events Q2. I'll share the PO once I have courier costs.
Maya: Can ops get SSH to the staging host? If so, share bastion IP + keys in a secure channel.
Samir: We'll create a short-lived IAM role and a dedicated subnet in staging VPC. Ops will get access by Thursday.
Liam: Proposed dry-run schedule: 30m slides + 30m end-to-end demo. Prefer 0900 PT two days before event. Any conflicts?
Nina: 0900 PT works for speakers. Please add runbook items: fallback model, demo prompts, screenshotting steps, and who toggles live routing.
Josh: Adding to runbook. Also requesting on-site AV: HDMI + USB-C + mic. CloudStack said table power is limited.
Maya: We'll bring a small UPS for the demo box. Also plan for local WiFi test and cellular hotspot as fallback.
Samir: Deploy-bot: created staging cluster for "cloudstack-officehours".
deploy-bot: staging cluster "cloudstack-officehours" created — kube nodes 3, model pool rtx-a100-xxlarge, endpoint https://stg-infer.redwood/internal/clouddemo
Nina: Perfect. Liam — once you get bios, I'll draft the co-branded event page and run the copy by legal.
Liam: Will send bios tonight. Also request a short quote from our speaker about the joint integration for the page.
Josh: Courier ETA request sent to partner hardware vendor. Will update with tracking.
Maya: Ops checklist to test during dry-run: 1) model load 2) KV cache warm 3) streaming latency 4) tool call demo 5) screenshot flow.
Samir: I'll add automated sanity checks to run 15m before the demo.
Nina: Great — action items: Josh = shipping & PO, Liam = bios & speaker quotes, Maya = staging infra & runbook, Samir = access + sanity checks. I'll own event page + legal signoff.
Liam: One more ask — can we pre-record a 3min fallback clip in case live demo fails?
Josh: Good call. I'll coordinate recording space.
Nina: Thanks team. I'll create/calendar invite for dry-run once bios are in. :calendar:
